transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
I... I came in because... I just keep thinking it would be better if I didn't wake up. Like... maybe dying would be the fair punishment for... for what I've done. To my family. And my crew at work.
Have you ever had a period when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable?
No... not really. I don't think I've ever felt like that. Just... like this.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A little over a year. Um... maybe a year and two months. It started... a few months after my husband got hurt.
Have you made a specific plan for how you would end your life?

No... I don't have a plan. Just... like I said, I just keep hoping I don't wake up. It just feels like... like dying is the fair punishment for what I did to my family. And my crew. But I haven't... I haven't planned how to do it.
Since these feelings began, have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. I guess so. I... I used to do a lot of things. Paint... cook big meals for everyone. I'd run before going to a job site. Even did community theater. But... I don't do any of that anymore. It all just feels like... like chores from somebody else's life. I don't really care if I miss it.
Over the past two weeks, how often have you felt sad, empty, or depressed?
Um... I don't know. I don't really keep track of the days. It's just... always kind of there, I guess.
How has your energy been during this time—have you often felt unusually tired or slowed down?

Yeah... pretty tired. Um... if I try to carry just one box of tile, or... or even just answer a couple of client messages... it's a lot. My body just feels like wet cement. And my head gets so tired I can't really make simple decisions. So... yeah. Slowed down, I guess.
During the past year, has there been a period of at least two months when you felt mostly back to your usual self?
No... I don't think so. Not that I can remember.
How has your sleep been since these feelings began?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really paid much attention to it. I just... sleep when I sleep, I guess.
Since these feelings began, have you been sleeping more than usual, less than usual, or about the same?
I don't know... maybe about the same. I haven't really kept track.
Since these feelings began, have you noticed any change in your appetite?

I guess so... I just, um, I forget to eat until it's late most days. Or I'll take a few bites and feel sick. My work pants have gotten pretty loose lately... I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, though.
Have you wanted to actively end your life, rather than only wishing you would not wake up?

I... no, I haven't tried to do anything. I just... I came in because I keep thinking it would be better if I just didn't wake up. Like... sometimes I feel like dying would be the fair punishment for what I've done to my family, and... and my crew at work. But I haven't... actually planned it.
Have you had any beliefs that others say are clearly untrue, but that you cannot be convinced are mistaken?

I... I don't know if they're untrue. People tell me I'm wrong, but... I know what I see. Even when I'm not feeling so down, I... I can tell the homeowners and the supply guys are watching me. They use the tile patterns I lay, and the text messages, and... and the calls for permits. They're tracking it all to see if I'm ruining the jobs on purpose. My husband says it's not happening, but... I know it is. They're all keeping tabs on me.
Have there been times when you felt generally like your usual self, without significant depression, but still firmly believed that people were tracking you?

Yeah... I guess there was a time like that. A few weeks, maybe, where I was... I don't know, getting out of bed okay. I was eating a bit more. Not crying all the time. But... I still heard that voice when I was on site. And I still knew they were tracking me. The clients, the suppliers... that didn't stop.
Was the period when you were not significantly depressed but still believed you were being tracked at least two weeks long?
Yeah... it was. It was a few weeks. Like I said, I was getting up okay, eating a little... not crying. But the voice was still there. And they were still tracking me.
